rules.title: Berkeley 2026 Annual General Adjustment (Regulation 1148)
rules.requirement: Eligible landlords may increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026. The AGA is set at 65% of the Bay Area CPI-U increase for July 1, 2024 - June 30, 2025.

coverage_conditions.summary: Rent-stabilized Berkeley units whose landlords are eligible under Regulation 1148; the AGA may not adjust rents for tenancies that began on or after January 1, 2025 whose rents were set under Costa-Hawkins.
coverage_conditions.other_conditions: Excludes tenancies beginning on or after January 1, 2025 with rents set pursuant to the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act. Landlords must meet the conditions and give the notice set out in Regulation 1148.

rules.exemptions: Tenancies that began on or after January 1, 2025 and had their rents set pursuant to the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act are not adjusted by the 2026 AGA.
rules.interaction: Interacts with the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act, which governs initial rents for certain tenancies.
rules.citation: Berkeley Municipal Code § 13.76.110A; Rent Board Regulation 1148
rules.quoted_span:
adopted the Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order for Year 2026 which will allow 
eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than 
January 1, 2026.
